text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] This Digimon may digivolve into [OmniShoutmon] under your Tamers without paying the cost. [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Play 1 Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait among them without paying the cost. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, ＜Save＞.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Rush＞.
